description: Open a Stripe checkout in your browser to add credits to your wallet (1 credit = $1; bought credits never expire, and every company you own draws on them). With `company` the checkout comes back to that company’s Billing page, else to your own. Nothing is charged until you pay there.

company.description: a company id (list_companies): the checkout returns to its Billing page
